purpose: First all-species headless ecosystem candidate. No rescue rules. This file contains only integration-specific parameters; species physiology/lifecycle parameters remain in phase2-phase6 fixtures.
notes: Initial counts, clonal timings, movement rates and decomposition multipliers are bounded engineering calibration inputs. Spatial habitat is 60x30 substrate cells across the 120x60 cm footprint (~2 cm/cell). Movement event rates are scaled by the square of the cell-size ratio so the diffusive physical displacement remains comparable to the earlier 10 cm grid; spatial integration samples net random-walk displacement over each ecological timestep. These are not biological population-density claims. Full-ecosystem invariant tolerance is explicitly looser than kernel tests to account for floating-point accumulation over millions of conservative transfers; it remains sub-part-per-billion relative. Bradysia mating radius is 6 cells (~12 cm) and Dalotia mating/prey encounter radii are 3 cells (~6 cm). These are CALIBRATED numerical encounter-kernel values that compensate for endpoint-only encounter detection over 30-minute spatial timesteps, not sensory-range claims or global access. Bradysia radius 6 was selected using calibration seeds 0-4: with Dalotia capture 0.20 and prey radius 3, all 5/5 150-day runs retained Bradysia and 4/5 retained Dalotia; radius 3 retained Bradysia in 4/5. Validation seeds were not used for tuning. Dalotia prey lookup remains restricted to the bounded local neighborhood.

dalotiaLocalCaptureProbability.notes: Phase-7 local encounter/capture proxy used only by the integrated spatial ecosystem. Calibrated on seeds 0-4 with a 3-cell prey encounter kernel and Bradysia mating radius 6; 0.20 produced Bradysia/Dalotia coexistence in multiple 150-day calibration runs without the prey wipeout seen at higher values. Phase-6 standalone chambers retain their separate 0.75 arena proxy. This is not a measured attack-success probability and validation seeds are not used for tuning.

dalotiaLocalPreyHalfSaturationCount.notes: Competition-aware Phase-7 local prey-density response calibration for the radius-3 spatial encounter kernel. After adding explicit sharing of the local prey-density response among nearby active Dalotia hunters, calibration seeds 0-4 were swept at 3, 4, and 5 for 180 days. Value 3 retained Folsomia, Bradysia, and Dalotia in all 5/5 runs while final Folsomia stayed 76-575; value 4 lost Bradysia in 3/5 runs, and value 5 produced Folsomia in the ~15k-36k range in completed runs. This is an engineering calibration for the spatial model, not a measured biological constant; validation seeds are not used for tuning.
